title: TF Perturb-seq Protocol
author: Nan Zhang
materials: For each screen, live single cells were isolated by flow cytometry after staining with LIVE/DEAD‱ Violet Viability/Vitality Kit (Invitrogen; L34958).
Libraries were sequenced on an Illumina NovaSeq 6000.

steps.title: Concentrate Lentiviral Library
steps.instruction: Concentrate the lentiviral library supernatant to 50X.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 100 mL of 1× lentiviral library supernatant into Ultra-Clear centrifuge tubes (Beckman Coulter; NC9146666).
Centrifuge at 25,000 rcf at 4°C for 90 min.
Gently remove the supernatant after centrifugation.
Resuspend viral pellets in 2 mL DPBS.

steps.title: Transfect sgRNA Libraries into 293T Cells
steps.instruction: Transfect the hTF library (13,266 sgRNAs targeting 1,983 human TFs and epigenetic regulators) and the control library (1,200 negative-control sgRNAs) into 293T cells.

substeps.instruction: Use JetPRIME (Cat. 89129-924, VWR) following the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Infect idCas9-KRAB HUES8 hESCs
steps.instruction: Infect idCas9-KRAB SOX17-eGFP/+ HUES8 hESCs with the 50X-concentrated lentiviral libraries on Day 0.

substeps.instruction: Infect 4 million cells with the hTF library at an average MOI of 10 in 10-cm plates (1 million cells per plate).
Infect 1 million cells with the control library at an average MOI of 10 in one 10-cm plate.
Add protamine sulfate (6 µg/mL per plate) during the first 24 h post-infection to enhance efficiency.

steps.title: Perform Puromycin Selection
steps.instruction: Select infected cells using puromycin starting on Day 1 post-infection.

steps.title: Induce dCas9-KRAB Expression
steps.instruction: Induce dCas9-KRAB expression using doxycycline starting on Day 1.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 µg/mL doxycycline to the culture media.
Maintain doxycycline until the end of the screen (Day 11 for ES condition or Day 14 for DE condition).

steps.title: Pool Infected Cells
steps.instruction: Pool cells infected with the hTF and control libraries on Day 7 post-infection at a 19:1 ratio.

steps.title: Maintain or Differentiate Cells
steps.instruction: Process pooled cells based on the specific screen condition.

substeps.instruction: For the ES screen: Maintain pooled cells in E8 medium until Day 11.
For the DE screen: Expand pooled cells in E8 medium, then differentiate for 4 days to definitive endoderm (DE), collecting on Day 14.

steps.title: Process for Single-Cell RNA-seq
steps.instruction: Process sorted cells for single-cell 3′ RNA-seq and sgRNA capture.

substeps.instruction: Use the 10x Chromium Next GEM Single Cell 3′ HT Reagent Kit v3.1 (Dual Index).
